casos.obtido:
[3/5] ```python
import bpy
import bmesh

# Criar um cilindro
bm = bmesh.new()
bmesh.ops.create_cylinder(bm, radius=1, depth=2, vertices=32, calc_tangent=True)
me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Cilindro")
bm.to_mesh(me)
bm.free()

# Adicionar o objeto ao universo
ob = bpy.data.objects.new("Cilindro", me)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)

# Remover a face de cima
ob.data.polygons[0].select = True
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
bpy.ops.mesh.delete(type='FACE')
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')

# Aplicar o modificador Solidify
m = ob.modifiers.new(name="Solidify", type="SOLIDIFY")
m.thickness = 0.02

# Renomear o objeto
ob.name = "Copo"
```

- [1] BMesh Module (bmesh): https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bmesh.html
- [2] Armature Modifier — Armature Modifier > Options: https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/5.2/modeling/modifiers/deform/armature.html
- [3] BMesh Module (bmesh) — BMesh Module (bmesh) > Keeping a Correct State: https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bmesh.html
